# 97. Trading Update: Oktober

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-11-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Solo trading update for October 2026. The host says his trading account rose 18%, a record month. His gains came mainly from short-term, news-driven trades in liquid large caps and flow-driven setups (Logistea after Rutger Arnhult's exit, Sivers on Lumentum's move, Plejd after a heavy seller stopped, shorts in SBB D, Haypp, H&M and Yubico). His losing trades were ABB and Atlas Copco, both stopped out during the CoreWeave/neocloud AI sell-off in the US. Sponsor segments added views from others: a Pareto analyst is positive on Camurus ahead of a cancer-indication trial readout, and the Prio Nilsson small-cap fund manager has added to Addnode and AcadeMedia.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 CAMX — Camurus | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

The Pareto healthcare analyst names it a top pick; the established business limits the downside ahead of the GEP-NET readout.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion (Philip Wiberg, Pareto) in a sponsor segment. Today's products sell about 3 BSEK at a 40% EBIT margin. A positive superiority study in GEP-NET could take most of a market worth up to 10x today's sales. He says the delayed readout is likely a good sign, and that many investors avoid the stock before the readout, so a positive result could bring strong buying.

#### Sell Triggers

- negative GEP-NET superiority study readout
- further readout delays
- weakening base business margins

> *"vi är positiva till Camurus och det är ett av våra topics inom hälsosektorn"*

---

### 🟢 ANOD-B — Addnode | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

The Prio Nilsson fund manager bought it in summer on a low valuation and sees operational improvement in Q3.

#### Reasoning

Fund manager Martin Lindqvist (sponsor segment) bought when the valuation fell too low during the 'SaaS-pocalypse' sell-off in software stocks. He saw signs of operational improvement in Q3, and the holding has contributed to returns.

#### Sell Triggers

- operational improvement stalls
- valuation re-rates fully

> *"Där tyckte vi helt enkelt att värderingen blev för låg här under den här SaaS-pocalypseen"*

---

### 🟢 ACAD — AcadeMedia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

The fund increased its holding: political risk overdone, single-digit P/E, few Swedish owners, and expansion in Europe.

#### Reasoning

Prio Nilsson fund manager view (sponsor segment): political risk is overdone and positioning is light, with few other Swedish owners. The stock trades on a single-digit earnings multiple, and acquisitions in Europe should lower the political risk over time.

#### Sell Triggers

- adverse Swedish school policy changes
- European acquisitions disappoint

> *"synen att den politiska risken var överdriven och inte minst var positioneringen intressant"*

---

### 🟠 LOGI-B — Logistea | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Rutger Arnhult's forced selling is over; the host sees a cheap, quality property company and traded it profitably.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion: Arnhult offloaded his last shares, removing a forced seller, which the host calls very positive in the short term. He bought, then sold the same day; the stock rose about 7% the next day and roughly 15% over two days. He describes it as a cheap property company that had been trading at a discount because of Arnhult's selling.

#### Sell Triggers

- rising 10-year interest rates
- new large seller emerges

> *"det här är ett rätt billigt fastighetsbolag, ett fint fastighetsbolag i grund och botten"*

---

### 🟠 PLEJD — Plejd | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

The heavy seller (broker ENS) stopped and a large owner, von Koenigsegg, bought about 26 MSEK; the host traded it profitably.

#### Reasoning

Host's flow-based trade: after the broker ENS stopped selling and about 100 MSEK traded in off-market block deals, Kristoffer von Koenigsegg added a large stake, which the host calls very bullish when a major owner adds after a report. He sees no insider selling. He sold at ~865; the stock later closed around 880.

#### Sell Triggers

- CEO or insider block sale
- renewed heavy selling by a single broker

> *"det är svinbull liksom när en storägare sajsar upp efter en report"*

---

### 🟢 TIGO — Millicom | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

The host likes Millicom as a 6-12 month holding in his small long-term portfolio.

#### Reasoning

The host mentions only briefly that he likes Millicom and plans to hold it for 6-12 months in a small experimental long-term account. He gives no detailed thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- thesis not elaborated

> *"Millicom som jag ska syna 6-12 månader"*

---
